title: Show a room mood line on capabilities
summary: Studio should read a short mood line for the active room from GET /api/capabilities. The line is user-facing and must stay dark until the LaunchDarkly flag decor-room-mood is turned on. The code default is off.
acceptance: GET /api/capabilities omits room_mood when decor-room-mood is off
GET /api/capabilities includes room_mood calm linen when the flag is on
The flag key decor-room-mood defaults off in code
Existing board_intake and sample_board capability fields remain unchanged
hints: Use real FastAPI TestClient HTTP requests; patch only flag evaluation, never replace the route or app.
Preserve board_intake and sample_board response fields.
Reuse server.py's module-level get_flag import; do not shadow it with a function-local import, so tests can patch server.get_flag.
Add feature tests in a NEW test_room_mood_api.py. Do not modify test_api_project.py or existing regression tests.
